title: Self-Healing Automations
summary: A framework that checks every stage of a recurring automation and repairs failures itself. It does a simple fix first, then lets Claude attempt a repair (kept only if the check goes green), and only pings you if both fail.
how_to_use: Ask Claude: "add a self-healing QC loop to this pipeline" or "make this workflow monitor itself". It wires your stages into qc-lib.sh.
requires: macOS/Linux bash and Claude Code. Notifications are pluggable (desktop by default).
